{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dravione aeries''' was a location on [[Dravione]].

[[Bleys Harand]] visited them in the hopes of finding an accurate representation of the face of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] and was told of a statue of Xim there. However, he found the courtyards empty but for a ruined statue that was missing everything above the calves. He recorded his journey in ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]''.<ref name="TEGTW AC 3">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref>
